coaching.headline: We converted six of eight won fights into prizes and closed despite three lanes reading unfavored.
coaching.team: The draft read unfavored on paper in three of five lanes -- carry, midlane and jungle -- with only the offlane reading favorably against Greystone. Lt. Belica opened first blood on Iggy & Scorch at 2.3. The skirmish at 6.8 went to them 0-2, flagged a bad trade, followed by a fight lost 2-3 at 9.1 in our half. From 16.3 on we started converting, taking their Outer Tower and then Fangtooth at 17.9. We fought that Fangtooth a body down after Murdock caught Wukong alone at 17.5, and still won 3-0. The costliest sequence of the night came at 21.3: a 2-4 loss left four of five of us dead and cost both our Inner and Outer Tower inside a minute, the single highest-significance fight in the match. From there we won every fight but one, trading a win at 26.2 for their Orb Prime across the map, and closed it out through Fangtooth, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth captures into their base. We finished with a 33-to-17 lead in majors and a lopsided 123,676-to-41,865 edge in objective damage, yet towers finished 8 to 9 -- they actually took one more of ours than we took of theirs, which is why a game this one-sided still ran 44 minutes.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three lanes read unfavored -- carry, midlane and jungle -- yet Legion, Lt. Belica and Wukong combined for 30 kills and carried the game anyway, converting six of eight won fights into towers or neutral objectives.
coaching.whatWorked: We converted six of eight won fights into a prize within ninety seconds, while they cashed just one of their three.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No tracked winning core exists for Scarlett to check this build against -- Mutilator, Terminus, Tainted Guard and Rebirth can't be graded as a gain or a loss without a baseline, same as in a recent film.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Lt. Belica completed the full winning core -- Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings -- and added Oblivion Crown, Caustica and Megacosm beyond it; nothing missing to question here.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult

enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies
